readme:
# Snapchat Profile Scraper

Get public Snapchat profile data by username. Give the actor a list of usernames or profile links and it returns one row per public profile: display name, bio, subscriber count, website, category, verification flag, images and related accounts. No Snapchat account and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One dataset row per public profile, with a `scraped_at` timestamp on every row.
- Usernames, `@handles` and profile links in the forms `https://www.snapchat.com/@nasa` and `https://www.snapchat.com/add/nasa`.
- A list as one line per entry, a comma separated string, or a JSON array. Numeric usernames may be given as strings.
- Duplicates (for example `nasa`, `NASA` and a link to the same profile) are fetched once.
- A status message at the end of the run that says how many profiles were delivered and which entries were skipped and why.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/snapchat-profile-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `snapchat-profile-scraper` to get the display name, subscriber count and website for nasa and nba. Return the results as a table."

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `profileUrls` | list of strings | Usernames or profile links. Leave empty to run the sample (`nasa`, `nba`). | sample |
| `maxResults` | integer | Stop after this many profiles were delivered. `0` means no limit. | `0` |

### Examples

```json
{
  "profileUrls": ["nasa", "@nba", "https://www.snapchat.com/add/kyliejenner"]
}
```

```json
{
  "profileUrls": "nasa, nba, mrbeast",
  "maxResults": 2
}
```

## Output

| Field | Example | Notes |
|-------|---------|-------|
| `profile_url` | `"https://www.snapchat.com/@nasa"` | |
| `username` | `"nasa"` | |
| `display_name` | `"NASA"` | |
| `bio` | `"Explore the universe and discover our home planet with official NASA snaps."` | `null` when empty |
| `subscriber_count` | `752100` | `null` when the profile hides its follower count |
| `avatar_url` | `"https://cf-st.sc-cdn.net/aps/bolt/..."` | profile picture |
| `hero_image_url` | `"https://cf-st.sc-cdn.net/aps/bolt/..."` | square hero image |
| `snapcode_url` | `"https://app.snapchat.com/web/deeplink/snapcode?username=nasa&type=SVG&bitmoji=enable"` | |
| `share_image_url` | `"https://www.snapchat.com/web-capture/..."` | preview image for sharing |
| `website` | `"https://www.nasa.gov"` | as written on the profile, so it can lack `https://` |
| `address` | `null` | |
| `category` | `"Government Organization"` | label shown on the page, `null` when none |
| `category_id`, `subcategory_id` | `"public-profile-category-v3-business-group"` | identifiers from the page data |
| `is_verified` | `true` | verified badge |
| `has_story`, `has_highlights`, `has_spotlight` | `false`, `true`, `true` | |
| `highlights_shown`, `spotlight_shown`, `lenses_shown` | `10`, `7`, `3` | items the profile page lists first; a profile can have more |
| `related_accounts` | `[{"username": "whitehouse", "display_name": "The White House", "is_verified": true}]` | recommended accounts on the page |
| `business_profile_id` | `"cb983b26-c537-474b-9699-065309205ea2"` | |
| `profile_created_at`, `profile_updated_at` | `"2019-05-22T17:38:27Z"` | |
| `scraped_at` | `"2026-10-28T09:00:00Z"` | UTC |

Optional fields are `null` when the profile does not show them. Export the dataset as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read it through the Apify API.

## Pricing

You pay per profile delivered, plus a one-time start event that is charged together with the first delivered profile. See the Pricing tab for the current prices. Skipped entries and runs that deliver nothing are not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops when the next profile would exceed it and reports that in the status message.

## FAQ

**Which accounts return a row?**
Accounts that have a public profile page, such as creators, brands and public figures. Many ordinary accounts and some well known brands have no public profile page. These are skipped, not charged, and listed in the status message.

**What does "skipped" mean in the status message?**
`no public profile found` means Snapchat has no profile for that username. `the account exists but has no public profile` means the username exists but Snapchat shows no public profile for it. `not a username or Snapchat link` means the entry could not be read.

**Why is `subscriber_count` sometimes `null`?**
The actor only reports what the profile page shows. When the profile hides its follower count, the field is `null`.

**Why are the `*_shown` fields not totals?**
Profile pages load their first batch of highlights, Spotlight items and lenses and load more on request. These fields count the first batch.

**What happens if Snapchat cannot be reached?**
The run ends as failed with the message `Could not reach snapchat.com (...). Nothing was charged.` and no profile is charged. Entries that could not be fetched while others succeeded are listed in the status message so you can run them again.

**How many profiles can I run at once?**
There is no fixed limit in the input. Profile pages are large, so a long list takes time. Use `maxResults` to cap a run.

**Is this affiliated with Snap Inc.?**
No. The actor reads public pages and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Snap Inc.

## Issues & Feedback

Found a profile that returns the wrong data, or a field you need? Please open an issue on the [actor page](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/snapchat-profile-scraper/issues).
